the students did not perceive any difference between a good accounting teacher and a good teacher of other subjects; the academic staff and the student were in agreement about the main attributes of good teaching; the students were not aware of the research carried out by the academic staff; the academic staff did not perceive any relationship between research and teaching; and the academic staff did perceive that the students were not interested in research.

there is no evidence to suggest that research makes teachers good.
